{"code": "# Compute mean biomarker change by arm and severity
stratified_change = valid_df.groupby(['arm', 'severity'])['biomarker_change'].mean().reset_index()

# Pivot to get arms as columns
stratified_pivot = stratified_change.pivot(index='severity', columns='arm', values='biomarker_change')
stratified_pivot.columns = ['control', 'treatment']
stratified_pivot['diff'] = stratified_pivot['treatment'] - stratified_pivot['control']

# Compute weighted average of the treatment effect, weighted by the proportion of each severity level in the full valid sample
valid_total = len(valid_df)
severity_counts = valid_df['severity'].value_counts(normalize=True)

# Weighted average treatment effect
weighted_diff = (stratified_pivot['diff'] * severity_counts).sum()

# Output
print("\nMean biomarker change by arm and severity:")
print(stratified_pivot)

print(f"\nWeighted average difference in biomarker change (treatment - control): {weighted_diff:.2f}")"}
